title: DataForSEO MCP Endpoint Mapping Contract v1.0
description: Meta-schema for the DataForSEO MCP integration contract (§13). Validates a registry document grouping MCP endpoints into 7 architectural categories (serp_live, keyword_data, labs, ai_optimization, content_analysis, backlinks, business_data). MCP server version is locked to dataforseo-mcp-server@2.8.9 (§13.1). Every endpoint MUST declare output_fields_keep + output_fields_drop (§13.3) for response shrinkage before staging, and cost.credits_per_call (§13.4) for budget enforcement. URL normalization applies to any endpoint whose output_fields_keep includes url-bearing fields — staging rows carry both url_original and url_normalized. TR market gap workaround (Q-DFS-MCP-01): dataforseo-mcp-server@2.8.9 wrapper does not always forward location_code/language_code in keyword_data + labs categories — server falls back to location_code=2840 (US) + language_code="en" even when caller specifies location_code=2792 (TR) + language_code="tr". Workaround codified in scripts/ingestion/dfs_pull.py: line 10 docstring overview + 331-347 _read_response_locale detection + 412 _retry_with_explicit_locale + 470 _enforce_tr canonical paterni. Live test 1835229 confirmed honored TR after retry. dfs_pull.py 1073 lines comprehensive workaround production-ready, no schema bump required.

mcp_server_version.description: Lock: dataforseo-mcp-server@2.8.9 (npm verified 2026-04-20; @dataforseo/mcp-server scope returns E404). Changing this const is a schema revision.

url_normalization.description: Every endpoint whose output_fields_keep contains a url-bearing path MUST write both url_original and url_normalized to staging. Join keys across sheets use url_normalized only.

budget_policy.description: §13.4 cost control contract. Runtime reads project.config.dataforseo.budget_credits_per_day; pre-call estimator sums endpoint cost.credits_per_call across planned calls.

endpoint_groups.description: 7 architectural endpoint categories. Keys are the fixed vocabulary; values are endpointGroup containers.

dfsMcpTool.description: DataForSEO MCP tool identifier. Convention: dataforseo__<namespace>_<verb>. Prefix is enforced; suffix is free-form because DFS MCP exposes 70+ tools and new ones may be added without schema revision.

cost.description: Per-call cost metadata. credits_per_call is mandatory; typical_rows hints response size for SQLite sizing.

inputField.description: Same shape as GSC mapping inputField: either declares a static type or binds to project.config.* via source path.

fieldPath.description: Dot/bracket path into the MCP response (e.g. items[].rank_absolute, history[-12:], citations[].domain). Not strictly regex-validated — used descriptively by the field filter.

output_fields_keep.description: §13.3 — whitelist of response paths persisted to staging. Must be non-empty; endpoints with no payload of interest should not be registered.

output_fields_drop.description: §13.3 — explicit blacklist documented for auditors. May be empty when the response shape has no known bulk fields to strip. Empty array still counts as an explicit policy declaration.

fallback.description: Free-text fallback recipe when the DFS tool errors (e.g. 'scrapling.bulk_get with google.com search URL').

endpoints.description: Endpoint-key → endpoint object. Keys are free-form (DFS MCP exposes ~70 tools; restricting them to a fixed enum would block future additions).
